description: Everything a page shares, in one shape. A claimed page (creator or business): its Rates with their stable ids, price as the page shows it (visibility full, from_price or request_only), how each is charged (once, hour, day, night, person, project), guests it fits, whether it takes requests now (open, paused, fully_booked), what it includes, the questions asked on a request (answer them in submit_request), and when it last changed. An unclaimed business page: public facts with their sources, its location, phone and own channels, marked unclaimed, with no prices and no requests: send the person to its own channels.
